thread:
Maya (Design): quick design check — thinking about the timeline scrubber for rollouts. current protos show a draggable playhead but we don't have clear keyboard affordances or announcement copy for rollbacks. thoughts? Ben (Product): agree — keyboard first. users running audits will need to jump to versions quickly. can we add step points for each version snap? Samir (Eng): step points are fine. will need to cap at ~50 snaps in long histories, otherwise performance and clutter. we can virtualize rendering. Lina (Accessibility): +1 keyboard. also need ARIA live announcements when focus lands on a snap or when rollback is triggered. sample: ```html
Version 3 — deployed 2025-03-12
``` Maya (Design): thanks Lina — that snippet helps. microcopy question: when a user hovers/seeks over a snap, should we show "Preview v3 — 10% canary" or "v3 (canary 10%)"? short and scannable preferred. Ben (Product): prefer "v3 — canary 10%". consistent with other UI labels. Chris (PM): also consider verbs for rollback CTA: currently says "Rollback to this version" — suggestion to change to "Revert traffic to v3" to make it explicit about traffic state. Samir (Eng): subtle but ok. backend returns a transient job id when rollback starts — DeployBot will post status updates. can we show a non-modal confirmation and then stream DeployBot messages into the timeline? Maya (Design): yes, non-modal confirm with mock: "Revert traffic to v3? This will route all new requests to v3. Existing requests will finish. [Cancel] [Revert traffic]". after click, show inline activity row and hand off to DeployBot. DeployBot: deploy 1847 started: reverting traffic to v3. ETA ~90s. :rocket: Lina (Accessibility): for the confirm, ensure focus is trapped while visible and the primary action is first in DOM for screen reader ordering. add `aria-describedby` to explain consequences. Also announce when the revert completes via live region. Ben (Product): visual affordances: add an icon for canary vs A/B test vs rollout wave. small dot+label. Also we should expose quick filters: "show only canaries". Maya (Design): one more: scrubber keyboard interactions — left/right arrow moves by snap, shift+arrows by major version, space toggles play, home/end jump to start/end. Lina ok with those? Lina (Accessibility): good mapping. document in keyboard table and add visible focus ring styles for high-contrast modes. Samir (Eng): noted. I'll implement snap virtualization, aria-live hook, and DeployBot integration. ETA: PR next week. Maya (Design): awesome. Action items: - Samir: PR w/ aria + snap rendering (due next Tue) - Lina: write accessibility doc snippets for keyboard and live region copy (due Fri) - Ben/Chris: finalize microcopy for confirmation and scrub labels - Maya: update prototype and add subtle iconography for "canary / A/B / wave" Ben (Product): :thumbsup: Chris (PM): filing a follow-up ticket to track analytics: capture "scrub to snap" events. Maya (Design): thanks all — will drop updated Figma and follow-up in this thread.
__notes: This thread captures a short design review about timeline scrubber accessibility, microcopy, and rollback flow integration with DeployBot. Messages are kept Slack-style short.
